Join us for a fun Fundraiser! The link will be live at 7PM and the TALES will start at 7:30PM.

About this event

Storytelling is arguably the oldest art form. Even before language, cave dwellers put stories on the walls. When populations were illiterate, storytelling helped communities learn about their world, teach children and adults with parables and fables, and provide entertainment that needed nothing but a place to sit and a teller.

As friends and members of Florida Poodle Rescue, we all have stories and love to hear them. Maureen Belote, loving person to Teddy whom she adopted from FPR in 2018, wanted to help raise funds and awareness of FPR when the usual fundraising events were canceled.

Maureen is a professional storyteller and has brought together a group of Tellers from Florida, North Carolina, and Ohio to move and entertain you right in your own home. Adults and children alike will enjoy Dogs Have Tales! Tellers will share true and fanciful stories via Zoom that will be available for a mere $15 donation.

The event will be held on September 10th, 2022 from 7:30 PM till 9 PM EST. Florida Poodle Rescue Founder, Tricia Robles will share about her first poodle and how she was inspired to start FPR. Mark your calendars and get a comfy seat by the computer for this event. If you can’t be available when the program first airs, you will still be able to access the link for one week to watch at your convenience.
